description: NHFLOW explicit (A 510 2, A 520 2, A 509 0): two basins 4 m deep joined by a gap one cell wide (4 m) in a wall of dry land (T 10, 2 m above the water), the water of the west basin 0.5 m higher. The cells of the gap have dry cells on both sides in y and stay wet, the water runs through (gauges in the gap at x = 58 and 62 m and behind it). 'avoid isolated wetdry' of nhflow_fsf_f::wetdry dried such cells before: no water passed.
covers: nhflow_fsf_f::wetdry: a wet cell is dried when it is closed in x and in y
